$comment: The one description of what the shared executor (execute_skill.py) accepts. Each curated skill's operation is this template with the skill's own name and artifacts; the skill help is written from it, and test/curatedOperationSchema.test.mjs holds it equal to the executor's argparse flags and size limits, so the help cannot say a flag or a bound the executor does not have.

operation.summary: Run the skill's deterministic baseline on a request or a data file and write results, a report and an execution receipt.
operation.summaryZh: 对一个请求文件或数据文件运行该技能的确定性基线，写出结果、报告和执行回执。
limits: 输入文件必须是普通文件（不是符号链接），非空且不超过 32 MiB
文本字段最多 2000000 个字符
基线是有意收窄的：超出它的方法会在报告里写明，需要改用更完整的流程

params.name: --input
params.description: 请求文件（.json 对象）或数据文件；不给时必须加 --smoke

params.name: --output-dir
params.description: 输出目录，不存在会创建，不能是符号链接

params.name: --smoke
params.description: 不带输入时用该技能的内置小样例运行
